Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the application. Really glad the demo landed.

High level: we can be flexible, but need to align on a few guardrails to protect both parties and our reserved capacity commitments for the pilot. Proposed compromise:
- Net45 for the first 12 months, subject to an approved credit application and a one-time pre-pay hold equal to the estimated first-month usage (applied to month 1 invoice).
- Staged invoicing: two invoices/month (5th and 20th) to match your suggested cadence; detailed billing CSV on each invoice.
- VAT: Redwood will invoice gross to your EU entity; your team provides VAT registration documents and reimbursement timing preferences so we can include a VAT line item and a credit flow when reclaim occurs.

Can you confirm the expected monthly spend range for the pilot (USD), and if Lumenix can approve the pre-pay hold via PO or an agreed credit card on file? If yes, I can get Finance to issue the formal SOW/terms and have Marissa run risk/limit checks.

Cc'ing Marissa and Aditya to accelerate credit and tax evidence.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
